recipes.title: Kashk Bademjan
steps: Peel the eggplants and cut them into thick slices. Sprinkle with salt and let them rest for 15 minutes to remove bitterness.
Rinse the eggplant slices and pat them dry with paper towels.
Fry the eggplant slices in hot oil until golden brown on both sides. Set aside on paper towels to drain.
In the same pan, fry the onions over medium heat until deeply golden and caramelised, about 15 minutes.
Add the garlic and turmeric to the onions and sauté for another 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the fried eggplant to the pan and mash everything together gently with a fork.
Stir in half of the kashk and mix well. Simmer on low heat for 5 minutes.
Transfer to a serving dish, drizzle the remaining kashk on top, and garnish with dried mint and crispy fried onions.

recipes.title: Kuku Sabzi
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh fenugreek leaves (or 1 tbsp dried)
Salt, pepper, and turmeric to taste
steps: Wash and finely chop all the fresh herbs. The herbs should make up the majority of the frittata.
In a large bowl, crack the eggs and beat them lightly.
Add all the chopped herbs, walnuts, barberries, baking powder, salt, pepper, and turmeric to the eggs. Mix well.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan over medium-low heat.
Pour the egg and herb mixture into the pan and spread it evenly.
Cover the pan with a lid and cook on low heat for 15–20 minutes until the bottom is set and golden.
Carefully flip the kuku using a large plate: slide it onto the plate, then invert back into the pan.
Cook the other side uncovered for another 10 minutes until golden. Slice and serve warm or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Ghormeh Sabzi
ingredients: 500g lamb or beef, cut into chunks
1 cup fresh fenugreek leaves (or 2 tbsp dried)
1 cup fresh chives or leeks, finely chopped
steps: Fry the chopped herbs in 1 tbsp of oil over medium heat, stirring frequently, for about 20 minutes until they are very dark and fragrant. This step is crucial for depth of flavour.
In a separate large pot, fry the diced onion in 2 tbsp of oil over medium heat until golden.
Add the meat pieces to the onion, increase heat to high, and brown on all sides.
Add turmeric and pepper, stir to coat the meat, and cook for 2 more minutes.
Add 3 cups of boiling water to the pot, reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for 45 minutes.
Add the fried herbs, kidney beans, and dried limes to the pot.
Season generously with salt, cover and simmer on very low heat for 1.5 to 2 hours, stirring occasionally.
Taste and adjust salt. The stew should be thick and very dark green. Remove the dried limes before serving. Serve with saffron rice.

recipes.title: Gheymeh
ingredients: 1/4 tsp saffron, dissolved in 2 tbsp hot water
steps: Soak the yellow split peas in cold water for 30 minutes, then drain.
Fry the onion in oil over medium heat until golden. Add the meat and brown on all sides.
Add turmeric, cinnamon, salt and pepper. Stir and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the tomato paste and cook, stirring, for 3 minutes until it darkens slightly.
Add 3 cups of boiling water, the drained split peas, and the dried limes.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover and simmer for 45 minutes.
Add the dissolved saffron, stir gently, and continue cooking for another 30 minutes until the peas are soft and the stew has thickened.
While the stew finishes, fry thin-cut potatoes until golden and crispy. Serve the gheymeh topped with the crispy fries.

recipes.title: Veggie Pizza
steps: Preheat your oven to 250°C (480°F) or as high as it goes. Place a baking tray or pizza stone inside to heat up.
On a floured surface, stretch the pizza dough out into a thin round, about 30 cm in diameter.
Spread the tomato sauce evenly over the dough, leaving a 1 cm border for the crust.
Scatter 2/3 of the mozzarella evenly over the sauce.
Arrange the bell pepper, onion, mushrooms, and olives on top.
Scatter the remaining mozzarella over the vegetables. Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with oregano.
Carefully slide the pizza onto the hot tray or stone. Bake for 12–15 minutes until the crust is golden and the cheese is bubbling.
Remove from the oven, let rest for 2 minutes, then slice and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Falafel Sandwich
ingredients: Tahini sauce, tomato, cucumber, pickles to serve
steps: Drain the soaked chickpeas thoroughly. Do not use canned chickpeas — they are too wet.
Add chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, coriander, cumin, coriander powder, salt and pepper to a food processor. Pulse until you get a coarse, grainy mixture — not a smooth paste.
Transfer to a bowl, add the baking soda and mix. Refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Heat oil in a deep pan to 180°C (350°F). Using wet hands or a falafel scoop, shape the mixture into small balls or patties.
Fry the falafel in batches for 3–4 minutes until deep golden brown all over. Do not crowd the pan.
Drain on paper towels. Taste one and adjust seasoning if needed.
Warm the pita breads. Open each one and spread a generous amount of tahini sauce inside.
Fill with falafel, sliced tomato, cucumber, pickles, and extra tahini. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Cheeseburger
steps: Divide the ground beef into two equal portions. Gently shape each into a patty about 1.5 cm thick. Press a small indent in the centre with your thumb to prevent bulging.
Season both sides generously with salt and black pepper just before cooking.
Heat a cast-iron pan or griddle over high heat until very hot. Brush with a little oil.
Cook the patties for 3–4 minutes without moving them to build a crust. Flip once.
Immediately place a cheese slice on each patty. Cook for another 2 minutes for medium doneness.
Meanwhile, toast the buns cut-side down in butter until golden.
Mix mayo, ketchup, and mustard for the burger sauce. Spread on both halves of the buns.
Layer the bottom bun: lettuce, tomato, patty with cheese, pickles, onion, and the top bun. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Pepperoni Pizza
steps: Preheat your oven to 250°C (480°F) with a baking tray or pizza stone inside.
Stretch the dough on a floured surface into a thin 30 cm round.
Mix the tomato sauce with garlic powder and spread over the dough, leaving a 1 cm border.
Cover the sauce with a thick, even layer of mozzarella.
Arrange the pepperoni slices on top of the cheese, overlapping slightly.
Sprinkle with oregano and chili flakes. Drizzle with olive oil.
Slide onto the hot tray and bake for 12–15 minutes until crust is deeply golden and pepperoni edges are crisp.
Rest for 2 minutes before slicing. The pepperoni cups will hold a little pool of oil — that's the best part.
